diagnosis: The revert_to_draft action fetches PublishedArticle using get_object_or_404 without verifying that the article belongs to the user's news organization or magazine. An authenticated journalist from Publication A can trigger the revert_to_draft FSM transition on live articles belonging to Publication B, de-publishing breaking news stories.
exploit_request:
POST /api/newsroom/articles/10941/revert-to-draft/ HTTP/1.1
Host: cms.media-syndicate.com
Authorization: Bearer <journalist_token>
Content-Length: 0
